Liebermann’s text checked and corrected against Die Gesetze der Angelsachsen I, p. 230.

Liebermann’s text corrected against Gesetze I, p. 230: “⁊ gif he þæt ordal forfleo, gilde se borh hine be his were.” → “⁊ gif he þæt ordal forfleo, gilde se borh hine be his were. (expanded letters in italics: æt)”.
The modern editor’s translation corrected against Robertson, p. 67: “[the fugitive's]” → “(the fugitive’s)”.

div.head: III Atr 6.2
div.ab: ⁊ gif he þæt ordal forfleo, gilde se borh hine be his were.
Et si fugiet ab ordalio, reddat eum plegius wera sua.
⁊ gif he þæt ordal forfleo, gilde se borh hine be his were.
Und wenn [Beklagt]er dem Ordal entflieht, so entgelte ihn [sein] Bürge durch sein [des Flüchtlings] Wergeld.
And if [the accused] flees from the ordeal, let [his] surety pay for him with his [the fugitive's] wergild.
And if he (the accused) flees from the ordeal, his surety shall pay for him to the amount of his (the fugitive’s) wergeld.
And if he flees from the ordeal, the surety is to pay for him with his wergild.

note.seg: Der Satz sollte eigenes Kapitel bilden.—‘according’ Price-Thorpe, falsch laut I Atr 1, 7
This sentence ought to form a chapter of its own. — ‘according’ Price-Thorpe, wrongly, in view of I Atr 1, 7
